We’re now looking for an IT Security Engineer. You’ll join our IT Security team, consisting of you and 2-3 other security experts. Your main focus will be monitoring and security hardening. Outside of the team, you will mainly collaborate with our IT team and the Product Security team.

Are you interested in a managerial role within the same team? Check out IT Security Lead.

  • Internal security tools: Build and maintain internal apps and scripts for access management and various security-related operations, such as bug bounty report intake, security training, incident response, etc.

  • Endpoint security hardening: Contribute to setting up and managing MDM and EDR systems deployed on the machines of our employees

💪 About You

  • IT background

  • On-site presence ideally twice a week

  • Interest in cryptocurrencies

descriptions.job-0an0n6s:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments and engage loyal buyers. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The role

Square is looking for a hands-on B2B content creator and storyteller to help Australian sellers understand what’s possible for their businesses with Square. You’ll turn seller insights, business priorities, product capabilities, and industry trends into clear, compelling stories that build trust and support growth.

You’ll own the content strategy and its delivery for Australia, within the wider Australian marketing strategy. Seller stories will be central to your work, alongside product narratives, practical business content, and industry perspectives. You’ll start with the audience, the business objective, and the story, then decide which formats and channels will bring it to life. A strong idea might become a seller film, an article, a series of social posts, or an asset that helps sales have a better conversation.

This is an individual contributor role that combines strategic thinking with hands-on creation. You’ll develop ideas, interview sellers, write and edit content, and take work from brief to publication. Your remit includes organic social, YouTube, creator and influencer partnerships, and seller case studies. You don’t need to be a specialist in every channel, but you do need strong creative judgement and the ability to adapt a story for different audiences and formats.

You’ll report to the Head of Marketing Australia and help shape the Australian marketing plan through your content expertise. You’ll work closely with sales, account management, and the sellers we feature, bringing in agencies and production partners where specialist support will make the work stronger.

You will

  • Set and deliver the content strategy for Australia, including priority audiences, content themes, an editorial calendar, and measures of success aligned with the AU marketing strategy. Advise the Head of Marketing Australia on how content can support business priorities.
  • Turn seller insights, industry trends, and Square’s products into original B2B stories, content concepts, and recurring series. Make complex business topics clear, useful, and relevant to the sellers we want to reach.
  • Create content yourself, from research and seller interviews through to writing, editing, and publication. Adapt strong ideas across written, video, social, and sales formats without losing the story or its business purpose.
  • Build and run a tiered framework for seller case studies, from fully produced flagship stories to lighter-touch photography and interview-led pieces. Define the scope, budget, and outputs for each tier, and choose the right approach for each story.
  • Plan how each story reaches its audience and gets reused. Develop content for organic social, YouTube, long-form articles, and sales conversations, choosing the right mix rather than requiring every story to appear everywhere.
  • Run Square Australia’s organic social presence, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Own planning, publishing, and reporting, and use audience insights to guide each channel’s role, publishing rhythm, and search and discovery approach.
  • Identify opportunities to work with creators and influencers who can tell credible, relevant stories for business audiences. Find, brief, contract, and manage those partners, and review their work before publication.
  • Brief and direct agencies, production companies, photographers, and writers. Manage work from concept to delivery, including timelines, stakeholder input, approvals, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, and budgets.
  • Partner with sales and account management to find compelling seller stories and understand the questions prospects and sellers are asking. Learn Square’s products so the content shows real product use and clear business value.
  • Use AI tools to support research, ideation, briefing, repurposing, and production. Build repeatable workflows that improve efficiency while keeping accuracy, brand voice, creative quality, and human judgement at the centre.
  • Measure how content supports audience engagement, seller consideration, and sales conversations, not only channel activity. Share what you learn and use it to improve stories, formats, and distribution.
  • Maintain content playbooks, trackers, and an organised asset library so the team can find, adapt, and reuse the work.

You have

  • 8+ years’ relevant marketing experience, with a strong track record of hands-on B2B content creation and storytelling.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills. You can turn complex products, business topics, and customer insights into clear narratives that connect audience needs with business priorities.
  • A portfolio of content you’ve personally created or substantially shaped, showing strong story angles, sound creative judgement, and a clear purpose for a business audience.
  • Experience setting and delivering a content strategy, managing an editorial calendar, and taking work from idea and brief through to publication and measurement.
  • Experience developing customer stories or case studies and adapting a central idea across formats. You understand how to choose channels and tailor content to how an audience uses them; depth in every platform is not required.
  • The ability to create and adapt content yourself, including written copy and lighter-touch visual or video assets, and the judgement to know when to bring in specialist support.
  • Experience briefing and managing agencies, freelancers, or production partners, including budgets, contracts, timelines, and approvals.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve content workflows, with sound judgement about accuracy, brand quality, and where human review is essential.
  • Confidence using content performance data and audience insights to improve topics, formats, and distribution, and explain what the work achieved.
  • Strong relationship-building and project management skills. You can work with sellers, sales teams, and other marketing partners, learn new products quickly, and balance planned work with changing priorities in a lean team.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B technology, fintech, commerce, or content for restaurants, retail, or services businesses.
  • Experience with organic social, YouTube, creator or influencer partnerships, or interview-led video production. Bring depth in the areas you know best and a willingness to build capability in others.
  • Familiarity with social publishing and analytics platforms, such as Sprinklr, Sprout Social, or Hootsuite, and design or video tools, such as Figma, Canva, or Adobe. Equivalent tools and transferable skills are welcome.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

Data Scientist

About the company:
 
Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
 
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.
 
About the role:
 
We are seeking a Data Scientist to drive data and analytics initiatives at Ondo Finance. This role will act as a force multiplier across product, engineering, and business teams, enabling better decision-making through high-impact analytics, insights, and data systems.
 
Rather than operating in isolation, you will partner closely with multiple teams across Ondo’s product suite (tokenized treasuries, equities, ETFs, Ondo Perps, and Ondo Chain) to identify opportunities, prioritize data work, and deliver insights that shape product strategy, risk management, and growth.
 
You will work with blockchain data tools like Dune and Allium to analyze on-chain activity, monitor market trends, and support key initiatives across trading, ecosystem growth, and product development. Success in this role requires not only technical proficiency in Python, SQL, and R, but also the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to stakeholders.
 

Responsibilities

  • Be our first data scientist - lead all efforts to track and measure Ondo on-chain and off-chain data and and analytics across products like Ondo tokenized equities & ETFs, USDY, OUSG and Ondo Chain
  • Be an onchain data wizard - you should already be deep in Dune, Flipside, block explorers, Birdeye/Dexscreener APIs, CEX APIs
  • Monitor and analyze relevant competitive and industry data
  • Develop and maintain client-side analytics Ondo web products
  • Have strong opinions on data infrastructure stack including BI tools/data visualizations, event tracking, ETL, data warehousing and feature flags/AB tests.
  • Support onchain accounting processes and operations automation
  • Generate data-driven insights for marketing, external presentations, and strategic planning

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of experience as a Data Scientist and/or Data Analyst
  • 1+ year(s) as a Data Scientist at a web3/crypto company or demonstrated experience working with blockchain data and web3 technologies
  • Strong proficiency in writing complex queries, statistical analysis and programming languages such as Python, SQL and R
  • Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies
  • Web3 product sense - you are a active user
  • Experience with and knowledge of DeFi
  • Strong proficiency in data visualization tools and BI platforms
  • Experience with ETL processes and data pipeline development
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to haves:

  • Public dashboards on Dune, Flipside or other open-source web3 data visualization platforms
  • Understands concepts at the intersection of on-chain data and DeFi like risk modeling, collateral ratios, MEV, oracle data feeds
  • Familiarity with market making and trading systems

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
  • Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices
  • A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
  • Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The Consumer SEO & AEO team helps people discover Kraken through search engines and AI answers, understand our products and become customers. We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The Electrical SME is Managed Services' electrical expert embedded in a data center build - supporting design review and commissioning witness to ensure electrical systems are operable and maintainable at turnover. The electrical system is the facility's spine; this role makes sure it can be operated, switched, and maintained safely by the team inheriting it.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:


Operability Design Review

Review electrical designs - MV/LV distribution, generator plants, UPS systems, EPMS - for operability: maintenance access and working clearances, switching practicality and arc-flash exposure during real operating procedures, redundancy behavior under maintenance conditions, and labeling/mimic clarity. Push back where the design assumes maintenance that can't safely be performed.

Construction - Phase Verification

Walk electrical installations at key milestones: equipment setting and clearances, terminations and torque documentation, grounding, and cable management quality - flagging operability and quality issues to the MEP superintendent early.

Testing & Commissioning Witness

Witness NETA acceptance testing and Level 3-5 commissioning: protective device testing, generator and UPS transfer sequences, load bank testing, pull-the-plug scenarios, and integrated systems testing. Drive operational findings into the Cx log and verify closure.

Turnover Readiness

Verify electrical turnover packages: test records and settings files, one-lines and as-builts, arc-flash labels matching final studies, spare breakers and critical spares, PM program inputs, and switching procedures. Confirm operator training covers real switching and emergency scenarios.

Energization & Early Operations

Support energization sequences and early operations stabilization: alarm and EPMS tuning input, operating procedure refinement, and first-months troubleshooting with the operations team.

Program Feedback

Feed operational lessons into Hut 8 electrical standards and future basis-of-design decisions.

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years in critical facilities electrical operations, commissioning, or NETA-adjacent field roles.
  • Deep knowledge of MV/LV switchgear, protective devices, generator and UPS systems, and EPMS/power monitoring.
  • Commissioning witness experience through integrated systems testing in mission-critical environments.
  • NFPA 70E fluency and real switching/LOTO experience - you've operated the gear, not just reviewed it.
